name: The Grand Palace
nameTh: พระบรมมหาราชวัง
summary: Bangkok’s royal showpiece anchors the old city with gilded halls, ceremonial courtyards, and the sense that every corner was built for statecraft and spectacle.

name: Wat Phra Kaew (Temple of the Emerald Buddha)
nameTh: วัดพระศรีรัตนศาสดาราม
summary: Thailand’s most sacred temple sits inside the Grand Palace complex, packed with mirrored mosaics, guardian giants, murals, and the revered Emerald Buddha.

name: Wat Pho (Temple of the Reclining Buddha)
nameTh: วัดพระเชตุพนวิมลมังคลารามราชวรมหาวิหาร
summary: A sprawling old-city temple famous for its giant reclining Buddha, tiled chedis, massage heritage, and calmer courtyards just south of the Grand Palace.

name: Wat Arun (Temple of Dawn)
nameTh: วัดอรุณราชวรารามราชวรมหาวิหาร
summary: The riverside temple everyone photographs at sunset, with a porcelain-covered central prang rising over the Chao Phraya.

name: Wat Saket (The Golden Mount)
nameTh: วัดสระเกศราชวรมหาวิหาร
summary: A hilltop temple climb in the middle of old Bangkok, ending at a golden chedi with one of the best low-rise views across the historic district.

name: Wat Suthat Thepwararam
nameTh: วัดสุทัศนเทพวรารามราชวรมหาวิหาร
summary: A grand royal temple beside the Giant Swing, known for its elegant scale, quiet cloisters, and old Bangkok atmosphere without quite as many tour groups.

name: Giant Swing
nameTh: เสาชิงช้า
summary: A tall red ceremonial landmark facing Wat Suthat, the Giant Swing gives the old civic quarter an instantly recognizable silhouette.

name: Wat Ratchanatdaram (Loha Prasat)
nameTh: วัดราชนัดดารามวรวิหาร
summary: This temple is best known for Loha Prasat, a rare metal-spired structure that feels geometric, serene, and slightly unexpected in the middle of Bangkok.

name: Wat Benchamabophit (Marble Temple)
nameTh: วัดเบญจมบพิตรดุสิตวนารามราชวรวิหาร
summary: A refined Dusit temple of pale marble, graceful rooflines, and polished courtyards that works especially well for a slower morning visit.

name: Bangkok National Museum
nameTh: พิพิธภัณฑสถานแห่งชาติ พระนคร
summary: The city’s major historical museum sits in the former Front Palace area and is a strong indoor stop for Thai art, royal objects, and deep cultural context.

name: Museum Siam
nameTh: มิวเซียมสยาม
summary: A playful history museum in a handsome old government building, Museum Siam turns Thai identity and everyday culture into an easy indoor stop.

name: Jim Thompson House Museum
nameTh: พิพิธภัณฑ์บ้านจิม ทอมป์สัน
summary: A lush canal-side compound of traditional Thai teak houses, art collections, and gardens that feels worlds away from the shopping district nearby.

name: Rattanakosin Exhibition Hall
nameTh: นิทรรศน์รัตนโกสินทร์
summary: A multimedia museum focused on the Rattanakosin era, useful for understanding the royal capital before or after walking the old city.

name: Bangkok City Pillar Shrine
nameTh: ศาลหลักเมืองกรุงเทพมหานคร
summary: A compact but important shrine near the Grand Palace, where locals come to pray at the symbolic spiritual foundation of Bangkok.

name: Democracy Monument
nameTh: อนุสาวรีย์ประชาธิปไตย
summary: A major civic landmark on Ratchadamnoen Avenue, this Art Deco-style monument gives political history and street geography a clear visual anchor.

name: Phra Sumen Fort
nameTh: ป้อมพระสุเมรุ
summary: One of the old city’s surviving fortifications, set beside Santichaiprakarn Park with river breezes and an easy sunset walk nearby.

name: Pak Khlong Talat Flower Market
nameTh: ปากคลองตลาด
summary: Bangkok’s historic flower market is at its most atmospheric late at night and before dawn, when garlands, orchids, roses, and delivery carts fill the lanes.

name: Yaowarat Road (Bangkok Chinatown)
nameTh: เยาวราช
summary: Bangkok’s Chinatown layers gold shops, old shophouses, temples, markets, and neon street-food energy into one of the city’s most vivid historic walks.

name: Kudi Chin Community
nameTh: กุฎีจีน
summary: A quiet Thai-Portuguese riverside neighborhood near Santa Cruz Church, Kudi Chin is ideal for narrow-lane wandering, heritage snacks, and multicultural history.

name: Memorial Bridge (Saphan Phut)
nameTh: สะพานพระพุทธยอดฟ้า
summary: A historic steel bridge over the Chao Phraya, best treated as a connector between old-city markets, Thonburi lanes, and river-view photo stops.
